paragraphs: Chapter 999
Episode 246. The Battle for Mithra Desert (9)
Kwaang-! Screech!
Two great swords struck the lower part of aerial fortress Rital. The warlords rode the currents created by the enemy's bombardment, tirelessly soaring into the sky, swinging their great swords.
They flew freely through the air as if they had wings. Hundreds of enemy cannon blasts failed to intercept them, instead colliding in the empty air.
"Where is the guy who was talking to us earlier? Come out, will you keep hiding in the aerial fortress?"
Beliz's voice roared through the battlefield.
'Shimat seems not willing to come out himself this time. With unexpected variables continuously occurring, he must be carefully assessing the situation.'
It was a safe judgment.
But Jin somehow felt that fate was smiling at him. To begin with, the summoned demons had worked more to Shimat's disadvantage, and he had never expected to meet his brothers so soon.
Besides, those who had prioritized safe judgment against him so far, most of them had eventually tasted defeat.
Sometimes, one must take risks and venture. In Jin's view, Shimat was failing to make that judgment.
'If you keep this up, you will eventually fall before me, Shimat.'
Jin leaped high into the sky, swinging Sigmund.
Golden lightning began to strike along the path of the descending sword. Each bolt of the golden thunder, the flat strike of the Royal King's Sword, carried the dignity of a great star.
Below, the great swords of Linpa and Beliz, above, Jin's golden lightning fell, continually breaking the shields of the enemy.
The aerial fortresses still held on without faltering, but the ordinary fleet could not avoid being hit except for the flagship-class vessels.
"Ancient Royal Kings? You guys are laughable. Is there really not one among you willing to come out and protect your brothers' ships that are continually being shot down?"
"That's right... It's strange."
Neither Beliz nor Linpa could understand the way of the enemy.
Perfect obedience, extreme totalitarianism. The enemy had nothing in common with the current Royal Kings from the very foundation.
Hence, Beliz and Linpa were even angrier. They could not tolerate these cold and treacherous beings using the name of the Royal Kings like themselves.
Shimat and the enemies heard their taunting voices but had no reaction. They were simply analyzing the battle power of the two warlords as planned.

"It feels like... like a small airborne fortress. As soon as the two descendants of Blue Plutonian appeared, Jin Runcandel has been conducting the battle as if I'm receiving support from an airborne fortress."
A small airborne fortress; that's how Shimat evaluated the two.
They seemed to be frantically dashing between the ground and the air, but upon closer inspection, they were moving meticulously centered around Jin.
They never strayed a certain distance from Jin, and most of the artillery that Jin could easily block was intercepted in advance by the two.

In fact, the royal fighters of the Ming Dynasty were very familiar with this kind of battle. Until now, the two kings would always fight together with Tuo Wang Jie Sword Baba at the center, but now the focus had shifted to Jin.
"Have you located the position of Qingfeng?"
{Not yet.}
The moment Bakarun responded to Shimat's words, another red dimensional gate opened in the sky above the battlefield.
"What? Instead of sending the captain out, they've sent another airborne fortress?"

Vessel, the fourth airborne fortress of the enemy forces, had space-jumped into the desert. Except for the Ulsrok and the airborne fortress of Kri, taken by Zipfel, this was the moment when all the airborne fortresses the enemy typically operated had been deployed.
Vessel was now planning to attack Lafrarosa according to Lima Gas's opinion.
Kiiiiii...!
As Vessel appeared, the wave of enemy energy that had spread like poison over the battlefield became even denser. Linpa and Beliz started to keep a closer distance to Jin, sensing the unease.
"Brothers, I believe that airborne fortress has appeared with the intention of attacking Lafrarosa."
"Lafrarosa!?"

"If they had called it to finish us off, Shimat should have already appeared. They have space-tracking technology. So, they're probably thinking of destroying the passage connected to Lafrarosa and Inselo, or striking inside it."
"Hmph! Let them try a hundred times, the Tusin brothers won't be fazed by that."
Jin agreed with that statement. The firepower of one airborne fortress wouldn't be enough to harm Vahn.
However, Vahn was now in a situation where he had to protect the plain warriors, and above all, he was concerned about the destruction of the passage.
'It's difficult for the Beliz brothers and the Linpa brothers to pay attention to the fourth airborne fortress. And if the three of us go deeper, I'm worried about Luna's safety...'
At that moment, a sharp idea flashed through Jin's mind.

Jin turned his head and looked at the demons wildly absorbing power spread throughout the desert. In such a short time, how much power they had absorbed, he could now feel a rather strong energy from all three of them.
"Hey, Masalun!"
Masalun, curled up like a dung beetle, unfurled his body and locked eyes with Jin.
[Why are you calling Masalroon, Jin Run Candle? Masalroon still has no intention of killing you.]
"Cut the crap, I have a good proposition for you. Are you willing to hear it?"
[A proposition...? What do you think the relationship between you and Masalroon is?]
"Another air fortress has just appeared. If you actively try to stop it, I'll ask if you can touch Shuri."
At this, a twinkling light appeared in Masalroon's previously dark eyes.
{Masalroon, touch Shuri...?}
"Yes. If I ask, they will probably listen. That much of a favor."
{But Masalroon cannot trust you. Humans, those orphans among orphans, have filthy and deceitful tongues.}
Jin quickly brought out Shuri.
[Meow.]
"Shuri, you heard?"
[Meow-nya.]
I don't like it.
Shuri replied that way, but to Masalroon's ears, it sounded the opposite. Only those who have long communicated with animals can understand their language.
{The Red Demon Clan, be ready. Masalroon is going.}
Jin doubted the intelligence of the newly summoned demons and made a regretful expression.

Regardless, he could feel a fighting spirit from Masalroon, who started running ahead, overpowering both Sribina and Kar Masher. In his lifetime, Masalroon had been the strongest among the three, without a doubt.
{Sorrow will curse you! The curse will plunge you into sorrow!}
Masalroon's specialty was a curse.
As he chanted a strange spell and stretched out his hand, the Red Demon Clan's psychic wave that was in front of him began to recede as if a curtain was lifted.
"Jin brother, what's with that guy? He was incredibly strong, right...?"
"A curse... If he's an enemy, he's a... troublesome one."
Where the psychic wave was, it was replaced with dense violet magical energy and magic, and at first, the Red Demon Clan thought they could easily dodge it.
But Masalroon's curse ignored the shield and instantly corroded the fleet inside, showing tremendous power.
Squeeeak...!

The sticky power of the curse was hitting the fleet directly, like light penetrating the shield. The closest ship turned into a black lump and crashed to the ground, melting away completely in less than 3 seconds.
"It's a curse I'm seeing for the first time. Is it a curse related to witches...? It's several times more dangerous than the curses handled by the demon gods of the demon world."
The Zekmyok clan had lost seven ships and managed to escape from the cursed area that Masalroon had spread, but the cursed area was moving along with them.
"Masalroon! You finally seem to be thinking of doing it right. Yes, let's quickly get rid of those Zekmyok brats and crush Jin Runcandel."
"Srivee, he's just doing that to touch Jokokmyo."
"Ah, I see. Still, let's go along with it; that friend is showing enthusiasm for the first time."
Srivee and Karmashu immediately began to support Masalroon. Following the curse, with Srivee's attack and Karmashu's flames, the vessel had to start its evasive maneuvers immediately.
The demons are still immune to all attacks. Even if the vessel is a powerful airborne fortress, it could neither suppress nor kill an enemy it could do nothing against.
Of course, the demons couldn't keep up with the vessel's maneuverability. The vessel circled the battlefield, dodging Masalroon's cursed area.
Occasionally, it would stop and fire a missile towards the entrance of Lafrarosa at maximum output.
Even Jin's party had to avoid it, as the terrible shockwave battered the entire desert.
Even the ordinary fleets of the Zekmyok clan scattered in haste to avoid the shockwave at that moment. Only the other airborne fortresses could withstand the shockwave with their shields alone.
"Those cannons are dangerous, indeed. But the half-brothers should be fine, though I'm still concerned that the passage itself could be damaged. Is the second team doing well?"
They were doing well.
The second team had just joined Luna and was analyzing the entrance to Lafrarosa.
"Kwak! That damned shockwave almost broke the device."
Inside the unmanned shield, Qwaul spoke as he took out a fist-sized device.

It was a makeshift space-tracking device based on Pibill's parts. Though not comparable to the Zekmyok clan's device, with the support of recording magic, it was capable of detecting any rifts in space.
"Dr. Qwaul, how is it? Is there some clue about Lafrarosa?"
When Hedo spoke, Qwaul nodded.
"The clue appeared the moment Luna informed us about the Myoung clan's Kings' grace! All that's left is to make a device that fits the passage between Lafrarosa and grace."
"Is it difficult?"
"No, making it isn't hard. Inspecting it myself, widening the passage itself will be very easy! The key is rather to secure enough time to use the device."
Eltiet nodded in agreement.
"You're right, Qwaul. My thoughts are the same. In this fierce battlefield, the device must remain undamaged and last at least twelve hours in order to summon the descendants of clarity."
"That's enough analysis, let's report to the leader and get out! Let's go back, make the device immediately, and discuss how to buy time."
